# Simulate and Run a GWAS

## Objective

Create a structured cohort, simulate causal variants and phenotypes, run a mixed-model GWAS, and benchmark recovery against known truth.

```r
library(simitall)
dir.create("results/gwas", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

simulate_gwas_cohort(
  genome_fa = "results/genome/simulated.fa",
  out_prefix = "results/gwas/cohort",
  n_samples = 300,
  ploidy = 2,
  snp_rate = 0.001,
  n_pops = 3,
  fst = 0.10,
  ld_block_size = 50000,
  n_causal = 12,
  effect_sd = 0.4,
  seed = 101
)

gwas <- analyze_gwas(
  genotype_file = "results/gwas/cohort.geno.tsv",
  phenotype = "results/gwas/cohort.pheno.tsv",
  out_prefix = "results/gwas/association",
  trait = "trait",
  fixed_effects = "pop",
  n_pcs = 3,
  min_maf = 0.05
)

benchmark <- benchmark_gwas(
  gwas$paths$results,
  "results/gwas/cohort.causal.tsv",
  out_prefix = "results/gwas/benchmark",
  fdr_threshold = 0.05,
  window_bp = 10000
)

plot_gwas_results(benchmark$paths$results, "results/gwas/association_plot")
```

## Report

State cohort size, ploidy, LD and structure settings, phenotype architecture, filters, association model, recovery window, precision, recall, and F1. Do not describe a recovered simulated locus as a newly discovered biological locus.
